properties.name_en: Jerusalem in the time of Jesus (First and Second Walls, before the Third Wall)
properties.name_ru: Иерусалим во времена Иисуса (Первая и Вторая стены, до Третьей)
properties.source: Own reconstruction. Temple Mount, Citadel and west wall from the public-domain OS 1864-65 survey; anchors from Wikidata (CC0): Antonia Q570515, Gihon Q204601, Pool of Siloam Q1483483, Mount Zion (Protestant) cemetery Q6924767, Holy Sepulchre Q187702. Course of the Second Wall and of the south wall on Mount Zion follows Josephus (War 5.142-146) and published excavation findings (Bliss & Dickie 1894-97, Kenyon); line placed by us, not traced from any modern map.
